newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Jan central gov't deficit $423 million.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Jan central gov't deficit $423 million.

text.p: Argentina posted a central government deficit of $423 million in January, the Economy Ministry said Tuesday.
The shortfall was 19 percent higher than in January 1996, when it was $356 million.
Total income came to $1.29 billion, up from $1.24 billion a year earlier while total expenditure amounted to $1.71 billion, up from $1.59 billion.
The figure was in line with government projections. The government is targetting a deficit of $1.04 billion for the first quarter.
